name: Evoq Remedies Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2010, EVOQ Remedies 
Ltd is engaged in the trading of pharmaceuticals formulation and allied products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
Company is in the business of marketing, trading, and distribution of a wide range of pharmaceutical formulation products. Apart from this, the company  also deals in trading of active pharmaceutical ingredients, Nutraceutical, Ayurvedic, and Herbal Products

pros: Stock is trading at 0.16 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 5.33% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 2.57% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.3.46 Cr.
Company has high debtors of 268 days.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -62.3%
